purpose: Descriptive, after v7's record and v7q (post hoc; not part of v7's deposited conditions), run once on the work PC: for M2_8B and M2_14B, in v7q's groups of sessions (by how D1's judgment moves from plan to page), the size of the planned gaps (each session's median and largest positive planned gap, and the share of its planned gaps equal to its median) and the size of the recorded gaps (each session's median recorded gap on hook and page, main cleaning). It answers what v7q left out: whether the sessions that flip and those that stay 'machine' differ in the size of their planned gaps.
fixed_before_running: Written on 2026-11-13 after v7q's record (SHA-256 73d17d13..., read on the Mac: the 11 flipping M2_8B sessions had no zero planned gap and delta 0; about half of their hook gaps were below 1 ms; the 11 that stayed 'machine' had none below 1 ms) and after attack-me round 2 of paper B's manuscript (the researcher's decision 11 of .steering/20261113-v7-production-v4-returns). The size of the planned gaps has not been seen. Code: works/prototype_v7r.py, committed with this file; it imports v7's analysis code at a6fa5ca and v7q (b40bfb8) unchanged.
count: For each captured session of M2_8B and M2_14B, its v7q group (the rule of v7q's m2_groups, written again in prototype_v7r.group_of and checked by a test to give the same groups as v7q), and: the median of its positive planned gaps, the largest planned gap, the share of planned gaps equal to the median planned gap (within 1e-9 ms), the median recorded gap on hook and on page. Per group: the count and, with at least 5 sessions, v7's summary (5th to 95th percentiles) of each quantity, plus the minimum and maximum of the median planned gap (these are planned values of a machine series, not of a person). Also, per group, the number of sessions whose median planned gap is below 1, 2, 5 and 10 ms.
reading: Descriptive only: no prediction, no test, no change of v7's readings.
limits: Post hoc, after v7's and v7q's values. M2's groups are small (11 and 11 sessions in M2_8B's two main groups).
record: results/prototype_v7r/record.json: counts and summaries only (no press time, gap list, key, text, LLM output or identifier; the minimum and maximum of a group's median planned gap are planned values of a machine series).
